messages.subject: An error with the unrooted trees
parts:
Hi Pro.YU,

I was trying to construct an unrooted tress with codes as below:
library(ggtree)
tree = rtree(50)
ggtree(tree,layout="equal_angle")

BUT there was an Error:
Error: Assigned data `2` must be compatible with existing data.
i Error occurred for column `end`.
x Lossy cast from `value` <double> to `x` <logical>.
* Locations: 1.
Run `rlang::last_error()` to see where the error occurred.

What can I do for it?
Any reply is appreciated.

Best regards,
Xiang LI
